faq.q: What is the origin of Edin?
faq.a: Edin is associated with Arabic. Edin is a Bosnian short form of Arabic عِزُّ الدِّين (ʿIzz al-Dīn), meaning 'might of the faith'.
Yes — the underlying form عِزُّ الدِّين is Arabic.
